purpose: Published two-mode reference scenario; not a calibration of the present FL_QOM device

source.citation: Mathew, del Pino & Verhagen, Nature Nanotechnology 15, 198-202 (2020)

mapping_to_current_model.omega1: approximate only; mode frequency was reported as approximately 2.4 MHz
mapping_to_current_model.omega2: approximate only; separation was reported as approximately 0.5 MHz
mapping_to_current_model.hopping: NOT_INTERCHANGEABLE: reported t2 is direct next-nearest-neighbour coupling, whereas current J_m is a phase-dependent nearest-mode term
mapping_to_current_model.detuning: reported as Delta=(omega_L-omega_c)=0.35 kappa; current model convention must be checked before sign conversion
mapping_to_current_model.phase: modulation phase phi_m is experimentally controlled, but the present model phase theta requires an explicit convention map

gate.reason: The source does not identify g0_1, g0_2, kappa_in, alpha_in or a direct calibration of the current J_m term.

required_followup_measurements: g0_1 and g0_2 or an experimentally fitted equivalent
present-device direct J_m and phase theta
exact omega1 and omega2 from the device spectrum
